title.en: Z.ai makes GLM-5.2 weights available under MIT license
title.zhHans: Z.ai 以 MIT 许可开放 GLM-5.2 模型权重

searchSummary.en: GLM-5.2 model weights appeared on Hugging Face in June 2026 under MIT terms; availability does not establish independently verified performance parity or production adoption.
searchSummary.zhHans: GLM-5.2 模型权重于 2026 年 6 月以 MIT 许可在 Hugging Face 上提供；权重可用不等于性能追平已经独立核实，也不等于生产环境广泛采用。

summary.en: Z.ai’s GLM-5.2 was introduced in June 2026. Its current Hugging Face repository shows a June 16 creation time and makes model weights available under MIT terms. Contemporary independent analysis distinguishes an earlier rollout from the June 16 publication of the weights. The company reports benchmark and cost comparisons, but the retained materials do not establish generalized independent parity with closed frontier models, production adoption, or that the Fable 5 export directive caused this release.
summary.zhHans: Z.ai 于 2026 年 6 月推出 GLM-5.2。其现存 Hugging Face 仓库记录显示创建于 6 月 16 日，并依据 MIT 条款提供模型权重。同期独立分析区分了此前的初始推出和 6 月 16 日的权重公开。厂商披露了基准测试及成本比较，但现有材料不足以证明该模型已在整体性能上经独立核实追平专有前沿模型、已被生产环境广泛采用，或 Fable 5 出口指令促成了这次发布。

narrative.en: GLM-5.2 became available as downloadable weights from Z.ai. The Hugging Face model repository is recorded as created on June 16, 2026; an independent June 22 analysis distinguishes an initial rollout days earlier from the weight and accompanying blog release on June 16. The repository describes an MIT license and a one-million-token context window. Benchmarks on the model card are company-reported; this record does not convert selected task results into an independently verified general performance ranking or an observed industry-wide effect. The nearby US directive concerning Fable 5 is a separate event. Chronological proximity does not prove it caused Z.ai’s publication decision.
narrative.zhHans: GLM-5.2 随后以可下载权重的形式由 Z.ai 提供。Hugging Face 模型仓库记录的创建时间为 2026 年 6 月 16 日；一篇 6 月 22 日的独立分析区分了几天前的初始推出和 6 月 16 日的权重及配套文章发布。仓库介绍了 MIT 许可证和 100 万 token 上下文窗口。模型卡上的基准测试结果由厂商披露；本条记录不将选定任务的成绩等同于经独立验证的总体性能排名或已观察到的全行业影响。同期美国针对 Fable 5 的指令属于另一事件；时间接近不能证明该指令促成了 Z.ai 的发布决定。

text.en: The GLM-5.2 Hugging Face repository was created on June 16, 2026 and offered weights under MIT terms; the earlier rollout was a different access stage.
text.zhHans: GLM-5.2 的 Hugging Face 仓库创建于 2026 年 6 月 16 日，并以 MIT 条款提供权重；此前的初始推出属于不同的可用阶段。

text.en: Vendor-run benchmarks and temporal proximity to US export controls do not by themselves verify general model parity, broad deployment, or policy causation.
text.zhHans: 厂商自行披露的基准测试和与美国出口措施的时间接近，本身不足以证明总体性能追平、广泛部署或政策因果关系。
